_boundary: Production of the BANZA protocol, not financial production. BANZA is an open protocol; it does not process payments, settle value, or move funds. Licence/authorisation belongs to the operator, not to BANZA.

compatibility.breaking_change_policy: A new major protocol_version is required for any wire-incompatible change to a production contract. Minor versions are additive and backward compatible. Patch versions are documentation/clarification only.

notes: Concrete production protocol version descriptor for the BANZA open protocol at the M2_PROTOCOL_IMPLEMENTATION state. 'Production' here means production OF THE PROTOCOL as an open specification (governance, contracts, trust path, release process, operator self-publication) — NOT financial operation. This descriptor is prepared-but-gated: while it declares the production contract baseline is in place, no real operator is created (operators stays []), no production certificate is emitted (production_certificates stays false), and no funds are ever held, moved or settled by BANZA. Financial services are provided by authorised operators that implement the protocol; regulatory authorisation belongs to those operators, not to BANZA. Advancing beyond M2_PROTOCOL_IMPLEMENTATION requires the Rust M2 protocol-gate engine (engines/banza-m2-protocol-gate :: validate_m2_protocol_gate) to report M2_PROTOCOL_IMPLEMENTATION_READY, plus explicit recorded protocol-governance sign-off on advancing the protocol milestone.

canonicalization.basis: RFC 8785 (JCS) restricted by the BANZA profile (ADR-082)
canonicalization.note: The byte form used for every BANZA signature and content digest. Versioned independently of protocol_version (ADR-081): a change that alters produced bytes requires BCJ/2.
